fusions.name: What the Reef Takes
fusions.desc: A scraping blow that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Staghorn Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts rusted spines out round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each one [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. [Bleeding] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Outcrop of Wreckage
fusions.desc: Plants an encrusted spar that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Living Rust
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
